h: Slough and a short hop to Windsor
p: The High Street is Slough's main shopping street, with Queensmere Observatory shopping centre right there, so this Admiral is very much in the middle of town. It's an adult gaming centre and 18+ only.

Slough gets a hard time, but it has a few surprises. The astronomer William Herschel lived here, and Herschel Park, south of the centre, is a restored Victorian park with lakes and woodland walks. The big draw nearby is Windsor, just a couple of miles away, with Windsor Castle, the Long Walk and the Thames riverside. Eton is across the bridge from there. Slough station is on the Elizabeth line, so getting into London or out to Heathrow is straightforward.
